question: Does an owner message attesting 'both lineups posted' / 'expected lineups' constitute a T-90 CONFIRMED-class starter capture for V14 eligibility?
owner_ruling_verbatim: 'Expected lineup' does not equal CONFIRMED. V14 should trigger only from an explicitly official/confirmed starting-lineup source. Lowering that standard merely to accumulate games would contaminate the forward test.
consequences: the 8/19 exclusion ledger's conservative reading is RATIFIED: all 15 exclusions stand as classed
the conditional MIA@PHI recognition-miss is VOIDED — under this ruling that game was never eligible, so no registration window was missed

prospectively: V14 eligibility requires a tier-1 capture that is explicitly an official/confirmed starting-lineup source; preview boards, odds-board starter columns, discretionary-message attestations, and 'lineups posted' phrasing all remain non-qualifying
the transport test stays at 0 eligible games until such a capture arrives — starvation is acceptable, contamination is not
